integrity: All mathematical claims are derived by explicit modular-inverse parity, a fixed-point-free unit involution, and a bijective square-lifting count. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The statement assumes odd \(a\ge3\) and even powers; the exact joint law is over complete reduced residue systems. A complete classification of square-bias equality is not claimed. The motivating 26-page preprint was not available for full-text inspection; possible overlap there or in unindexed literature remains. Finite replay supports but does not prove the infinite statement.
title: Exact independence of midpoint Diophantine solvability under even powering
